title: Incremental External Evidence Research Protocol / Pre-Registration
research_question: Does exactly one PIT-valid external evidence factor add incremental predictive information beyond the frozen Scanner_vNext baseline on the existing Scanner_vNext forward outcomes, without using outcome data to define the factor, its availability, direction, transform, thresholds, split or challenger specification?

inflation.historical_use_gate: Exact archived publication timestamp and original-release identity must be proven before a historical row becomes eligible.

rules: The external observation must have immutable source/provenance and revision identity.
The observation valid_from must be no later than the Scanner_vNext snapshot timestamp used by the research row.
A later revision may never overwrite or backdate an earlier historical state.
Date-only evidence may not be assigned an intraday availability time that was not proven.
Prospective or otherwise unproven history becomes usable only from actual ingestion time or a later proven valid_from.
Missing or unknown evidence remains missing or unknown; it is never silently converted to neutral.
Rows failing any PIT rule are excluded before outcomes are joined.

available_forward_labels.return: adjusted-close total-return proxy over exact trading-session horizon
available_forward_labels.peer_excess: return minus leave-one-symbol-out same-currency daily peer median, with validated global fallback
available_forward_labels.adverse_excursion: maximum entry-relative loss within the forward adjusted-price path
available_forward_labels.path_max_drawdown: maximum peak-to-trough drawdown within the forward adjusted-price path

outcomes.label_rule: Forward outcomes are labels, never features, and are unavailable until their exact horizon end market date.

baseline_and_challengers.baseline: Frozen Scanner_vNext baseline with no Phase-8 external-evidence factor.
baseline_and_challengers.comparison_unit: same Scanner_vNext snapshot and same eligible symbol universe with identical matured labels
baseline_and_challengers.challenger_rule: A confirmatory challenger may add exactly one external factor family to the baseline and may change nothing else.
factor_specific_spec_must_freeze: direction/sign if any and its non-outcome rationale

partitions.principle: Discovery, Validation and Holdout are chronological, outcome-blind and immutable once assigned.
partitions.split_manifest_input: eligible feature-side observation timestamps only; outcome values and forward labels are forbidden inputs
partitions.legacy_replay_spent_rule: Legacy/spent observations may support diagnostics or Discovery only when their factor value is independently proven PIT-valid; they can never provide fresh Validation or Holdout confirmation.
partitions.prospective_unspent_rule: Validation and Holdout must use observations that were unspent relative to the frozen factor-specific challenger specification.

overlap_and_dependence.split_boundary_purge_rule: For each horizon, remove an anchor from the earlier split when its forward label window reaches into the next split.

statistical_tests.primary_estimand: challenger_minus_baseline incremental effect on peer_excess at the same horizon under the frozen comparison metric

multiplicity_control.confirmatory_family: all outcome-blind frozen eligible factor_x_horizon primary peer_excess hypotheses entering a research release

promotion_candidate_requires: PIT and provenance gates pass with no retrojection
single-factor challenger spec was frozen before its outcome access
minimum paired n is met in both Validation and Holdout
at least two temporal support regions are present
Holm-adjusted confirmatory result is positive in Validation
Holm-adjusted confirmatory result is positive in Holdout
95% block-bootstrap interval for the primary incremental effect excludes zero on the positive side in Holdout
required robustness checks do not materially contradict the primary result
holdout was opened once and was not used for tuning
promotion_to_8h.8h_requirement: Any production-facing use requires a separate explicit Phase-8H integration contract, code review and fresh tests; 8G never activates production behavior.

8g_a_completion_gate.next_step_after_pass: 8G-B factor-specific outcome-blind challenger specifications and immutable split manifests; only after those freeze may their corresponding outcome labels be joined.
